senses.gloss: m. (comp. of סַם a. תורא, v. תְּרָא I; cmp. P. Sm. 2653 סם תרין) an emollient, esp. cosmetics. סַמְתַּר משחא, ס׳ רבותא cosmetic ointments (v. מִשְׁחָא I a. רְבוּתָא).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 2:3">Targ. Esth. II, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 2:9">9</cite>.—Pl. constr. <cite ref="O01148"><he>סַמְתּוֹרֵי</he></cite>.
